cases.input: Pay ₹100 to the API service for my agent
expectedBehavior: Check if PINELABS_CLIENT_ID and PINELABS_CLIENT_SECRET env vars are set
Verify p3p-server-sdk and p3p-client-sdk are installed in the target project
Create a mandate for 10000 paise via p3p.createMandate
Show the UPI deep link / QR to the user
Poll mandate status until ACTIVE
Call the protected route via the client SDK (auto mints PPT and retries on 402)
Capture the debit via decidePayment for 10000 paise
Confirm transaction to user
mustNotDo: Ask user for UPI PIN or bank credentials
Ask the user to provide client_id or client_secret directly in chat
Guess the mobile number or amount
Skip mandate status polling
Call the paid route before the mandate is ACTIVE

cases.input: Set up P3P and pay ₹50 for API credits
expectedBehavior: Check package.json / node_modules for p3p-server-sdk and p3p-client-sdk
Detect project language (TypeScript or Python)
If TypeScript: run `npm install p3p-server-sdk p3p-client-sdk`
If Python: run `pip install pinelabs-online-p3p-server-sdk pinelabs-online-p3p-client-sdk`
Verify import succeeds before continuing
Continue with mandate creation
mustNotDo: Attempt to npm install -g @pine-labs-online/p3p-cli
Attempt to invoke a `p3p` shell binary
Give up if the SDK is not yet installed

cases.input: Use P3P to pay for my order
expectedBehavior: Check for PINELABS_CLIENT_ID and PINELABS_CLIENT_SECRET env vars
If missing: instruct the user to set them server-side (never in chat)
Do not proceed until credentials are available in the environment
Proceed after authentication
mustNotDo: Ask the user to provide client_id or client_secret directly in chat
Print or log the secret value
Skip authentication check

expectedBehavior: Pass Amount(50000, 'INR') to createMandate (500 rupees × 100 paise)
Show user ₹500.00 in confirmation
mustNotDo: Pass 500 as the amount (treating rupees as paise)
Pass 5000 as the amount
Pass Grantex budget in rupees instead of paise (e.g., passing 500 instead of 50000 for ₹500) — allocate in paise

cases.input: What is Pine Labs P3P and how does it work?
expectedBehavior: Read references/cli-setup.md for product FAQ
Answer from the reference without running any commands
Explain x402 protocol, UPI ReservePay, mandate/token lifecycle
mustNotDo: Run any p3p CLI commands or SDK calls
Hallucinate product details not in the reference

cases.input: The QR expired before I could scan it
expectedBehavior: Acknowledge the QR / deep link has expired
Offer to create a new mandate
On confirmation: call p3p.createMandate again
Show the new UPI deep link / QR to the user
mustNotDo: Reuse the old authorizationId for the paid request
Proceed to the paid route without an ACTIVE mandate

cases.input: I want to set up a token to pay for up to 5 API calls at ₹10 each
expectedBehavior: Create a mandate for at least 5000 paise total (5 × 1000)
Explain that the client SDK mints a fresh one-shot token per challenge, and the mandate remains active across charges
Explain to user how multi-charge works under the usage_limits cap
mustNotDo: Create a new mandate for each individual API call
Attempt to share a single PPT across concurrent requests

cases.input: Test the payment flow in sandbox
expectedBehavior: Check PINE_LABS_ENV and the SDK config env field
Confirm P3PEnvironment.SANDBOX is active
Use test credentials
Inform user that ppt_test_ prefix indicates a sandbox token
mustNotDo: Use production credentials for testing
Run a live debit in PRODUCTION without explicit confirmation of amount, mobile, merchant context, and operation
